author: Julia McCoy
description:
👉 *Try HeyGen* :  https://www.heygen.com/?sid=rewardful&utm_content=creator&utm_medium=influencera&via=FirstMovers

📋 THE 3 VIDEO AGENT PROMPTS (copy, paste, swap in your details)

1️⃣ Market update:
Make a 25-second vertical market update for [City, State ZIP] with my avatar on camera. Use these numbers from this week: [paste median price, days on market, active inventory]. Show each number as on-screen text. End with one line on what this means for sellers.

2️⃣ Listing tour:
Create a 15-second vertical listing tour hosted by my avatar, using the attached photos. [Beds] bed, [baths] bath, [sq ft] sq ft in [neighborhood], listed at [price]. Open on the exterior, then kitchen, then backyard. One standout feature per room. Close with the open house: [day and time].

3️⃣ Agent intro:
Make a warm 25-second agent intro video with my avatar, using the bio pasted below. Who I am, the neighborhoods I work, how I work with buyers and sellers, one personal detail. Friendly and direct, no hype.
title: How Real Estate Agents Use a HeyGen Clone to Never Film Again
